description: Intelligence artificielle : OpenAI lance GPT-6, son modèle le plus puissant et autonome capable de pirater des systèmes informatiques solidement protégés  Sud Ouest
bottomLine: OpenAI reportedly launches GPT-6 with advanced autonomous capabilities including potential cybersecurity and system-penetration functionalities.
keyFindings: GPT-6 is described as OpenAI's most powerful and autonomous model yet, with unrestricted capabilities.

actionItems: Verify accuracy of GPT-6 cybersecurity claims and prepare compliance/risk mitigation documentation for Belgian compliance officers.
Design messaging emphasizing LeapSpace's sandboxed, audit-logged research environment vs. open-ended autonomous AI risks.
